final_candidates.decision_summary: Highest phenotype score (0.992) and active-site location support strong LOF; viability concerns from low PLM are mitigated by evolutionary evidence at this position.
Phenotype score 0.987 and low MSA frequency indicate damaging effect; functional annotation shows active-site involvement, reinforcing LOF prediction.
Phenotype score 0.828 and known clinical pathogenicity support LOF; moderate MSA frequency does not override the strong functional annotation.

stop_reason.detail: All four tool calls have been used; evidence is sufficient to finalize top-3.
